versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Climbers hang on a friendly unit and copy half of every stat it gains, passing gains down chains.
Build one big host, many small trees, or tiny roots that let climbers Bloom; Dodders steal from enemies.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Climb now says on the card what happens when a host dies (falling), bans loops, and keeps copies when a host loses stats; Bloom is checked once at Start of Combat.
Dodder Thread, Cousin Dodder and Lady Hedera are reworded to match, and Hanger-on pays more gold on a host with three climbers.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Climb now says triples drop vines, Honeysuckle Tendril says how two hosts work, and Mistletoe Clump reads as a plain 1/1 move.
Dodder Thread covers an empty slot across and a dead enemy host, which Old Man's Beard now pays out on; Hedera says a second copy adds nothing.
